current_role: Vice president of the Herzl Institute, Jerusalem; vice president and director of the Edmund Burke Foundation
summary: Ofir Haivry is an Israeli political philosopher and historian (born 1964), author of John Selden and the Western Political Tradition (2017). He co-founded the Shalem Center (1994), was founding editor of the magazine Azure, and co-founded the Herzl Institute with Yoram Hazony in 2012. He is on the board of the Edmund Burke Foundation, which runs the NatCon conferences.
